Type: wood end table with drawer

Style: traditional, rustic, classic
Materials: solid oak, medium oak finish, dark metal pull
Colors: warm honey oak, black
Shape: half-round top, single front drawer, slightly splayed square legs, lower shelf, compact and upright
Feel: warm, homey, crafted
Goes with: earthy tones, leather, cream walls; Craftsman, traditional or cottage rooms

product.name: Phoenix Home Tilburg Wood End Table with Drawer and Lower Shelf, Forest Oak
product.description: Wood end table with a small footprint; works well next to a reading chair, recliner, or couch Ruggedly built with solid wood for long-lasting strength and enjoyment Hand-applied multi-step finish; wood-grain accents bring natural warmth to any room Lower shelf for added storage or display; pull-out drawer with attractive metal hardware Measures 18 inches in diameter by 24 inches high; easy assembly (simply attach the legs and slide in the drawer)
